title: L2 loss channel-wise missing?
body: Hello I ve been reading the GestureGAN paper and the way in which calculating the L2 loss in the generator channel wise avoids channel pollution However I can not find it implemented in the code Only the L1 loss is calculated channel wise which the paper states that is not necessary Is this an error en in the code and when calculating L1 loss it was meant to calculate L2 Thanks

comments.body: Thanks for your interest in our work 1 You can replace self criterionL1 with self criterionL2 to obtain the channel wise L2 loss where self criterionL2 torch nn MSELoss 2 We also found that in our experiments the channel wise L1 loss achieves better results than the traditional L1 loss although in theory both should be the same
All right Thank you for the answer I ll try both and see what works best in my research
